description:
optional, enumerated string filter
Order type. Possible values are : manual, system_generated.
Supported operators : is, is_not, in, not_in

Example → order_type[is_not] = "system_generated"

is.description: \* \`manual\` - The order has been created by the the user using Chargebee's legacy order management system. \* \`system_generated\` - The order has been created by Chargebee automatically based on the preferences set by the user.

is_not.description: \* \`manual\` - The order has been created by the the user using Chargebee's legacy order management system. \* \`system_generated\` - The order has been created by Chargebee automatically based on the preferences set by the user.
